name: KuvarPay Payment Gateway for WooCommerce
author: kuvarpay

sections.description:
A secure and reliable payment gateway plugin for KuvarPay (KuvarPay Payment Gateway for WooCommerce), enabling seamless cryptocurrency payment processing for your online store.

This plugin relies on the KuvarPay payment service to process transactions.
It securely communicates with the KuvarPay API and loads the KuvarPay JavaScript SDK over HTTPS to provide a seamless checkout experience.
* Service URL: https://kuvarpay.com
* Terms of Service: https://kuvarpay.com/terms
* Privacy Policy: https://kuvarpay.com/privacy

Features

  • Secure Payment Processing: PCI DSS compliant payment processing.
  • Multiple Payment Methods: Bitcoin, Ethereum, and other cryptocurrencies.
  • WooCommerce Subscriptions Support: Full support for recurring payments.
  • Webhook Integration: Real-time payment status updates.
  • Test Mode: Safe testing environment before going live.
  • Multi-Currency Support: Accept payments in multiple currencies.
  • Mobile Responsive: Optimized for mobile devices.

External services

This plugin connects to the KuvarPay API and loads the KuvarPay JavaScript SDK
to process cryptocurrency and fiat payments through your WooCommerce store.
Use of the plugin requires a KuvarPay merchant account.

KuvarPay Payment API

  • Service: KuvarPay (operated by KuvarPay).
  • What it does: Creates checkout sessions, processes payments, returns payment
    status, and delivers webhook callbacks for real-time payment updates.
  • Supported merchant regions: Currently available to businesses and merchants in Nigeria, Ghana, Rwanda, Kenya, and South Africa.
  • What data is sent and when:
    • When a customer places an order with the KuvarPay payment method or visits
      the order-pay / order-received page, the plugin transmits: site URL
      (origin), order ID and reference, order amount, currency, line-item
      metadata, customer billing email and name, the merchant’s KuvarPay API key
      and business ID (server-to-server), and the configured webhook callback
      URL.
    • Inbound webhooks from KuvarPay are received at
      ?wc-api=kuvarpay_webhook on your site and contain the payment session
      ID, transaction ID, status, amount, currency, and event type. Inbound
      webhook payloads are stored in the plugin’s webhook log table for
      debugging; sensitive request headers (cookies, Authorization, API keys)
      are stripped before storage.
    • No data is sent until the customer initiates a payment or your site
      receives a webhook.
  • Terms of Service: https://kuvarpay.com/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://kuvarpay.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the kuvarpay-payment-gateway-for-woocommerce folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments > KuvarPay to configure the plugin.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require an account?

Yes, you need a KuvarPay account to process payments. Sign up at kuvarpay.com.

Is it secure?

Yes, all payment data is processed securely through KuvarPay’s servers.
